name: VoiceMoat
description: Hosted MCP server for VoiceMoat, the personal brand OS for Twitter/X and LinkedIn. Score drafts against your voice profile, improve them, get post ideas and opening hooks, read your analytics and top posts, and publish or schedule posts with a preview and a confirmation step before anything goes live. OAuth sign-in, no API keys. Tools need a VoiceMoat Pro or Enterprise plan.
author: VoiceMoat
